description:
Private access, at home in GNOME. Quick Settings, pause/resume, searchable favorites, account switching, and resource actions for the official Twingate Linux client.

Copies resource addresses and diagnostics to the clipboard when you select those actions. Does not read clipboard contents.

Fork maintained by aheinze. Originally created by urhend: https://github.com/urhend/twingate-panel

Community extension, not affiliated with Twingate.
name: Twingate Quick Access
